policy.semantic_transfer_rule: Methods, formats and provenance may be shared; domain conclusions never transfer without typed evidence.
policy.promotion_rule: A lane advances only with a declared consumer, explicit validator and evidence whose scope matches the claim.

lanes.title: P versus NP as a representation and search hypothesis
lanes.next_gate: Curate semantic fidelity between the official statement and formal target before truth promotion.
guardrails: No theorem claim from folder order or absent counterexamples.
Keep formal payloads behind trusted verifier references.

lanes.title: Tennis as an adversarial decision, perception and physics laboratory
lanes.next_gate: Add an independent second fixture or observed source before learning a general tennis policy; keep physics and counterfactuals unpromoted.
guardrails: Preserve raw notation and unknown tokens.
Observed human outcomes never evaluate an unexecuted MAK counterfactual.
Broadcast 2D, fatigue and spin limits remain explicit unknowns or proxies.

lanes.title: Research capture and scraping as source acquisition, not truth
lanes.next_gate: Resolve license review for the existing four-source capture before publication; the symbolic simulate consumer remains a model-only projection.
guardrails: Official sources and candidates remain separate.
A key or package does not prove a provider is operational.
Do not clone or install candidate repositories for an unavailable consumer.

lanes.title: Deep learning, embeddings and micelio as measured projections
lanes.next_gate: Provide an independent holdout for the existing logo-clean task and run its validator; no model training or semantic promotion yet.
guardrails: An embedding is a projection, not semantic truth.
Generated labels remain derived until independently validated.
Do not promote weights without a declared task and holdout.

lanes.title: Dialect transforms with explicit preservation and loss
lanes.next_gate: Implement one registry entry and golden fixture for a loss-declared transform used by a real consumer.
guardrails: Do not call every conversion transpilation.
No universal schema that erases domain semantics.
Projection and geometry never create epistemic relations.

lanes.title: Object-centric events as the shared memory substrate
lanes.next_gate: Select one existing MAK event stream and define an object/event fixture without introducing a second datastore.
guardrails: Shared event mechanics do not imply shared domain meaning.
Keep source, observation, interpretation and action separate.

lanes.title: Procedural growth as an explicit symbolic visual model
lanes.next_gate: Human-review the candidate visual grammar and compare a second declared grammar before any biological interpretation or publication.
guardrails: A symbolic trajectory is simulated, never observed growth.
Rules are input declarations, not extracted facts.
Budget overflow abstains instead of truncating silently.

lanes.title: XIO reels, attention and explicit preference
lanes.next_gate: Register one raw event stream and one explicit user mark before inferring preference.
guardrails: Dwell and replay are policy-conditioned observations, not preference truth.
Ask selectively when an explicit label reduces uncertainty.

lanes.title: Interview and audiovisual turns to claims with evidence
lanes.next_gate: Create a human-audited sample of turns-to-claims with non-claims retained.
guardrails: Extraction is not verification.
Question, answer, repair and claim keep distinct identities.

lanes.title: Mandarin and LSCh as learning-objective compilation
lanes.next_gate: Declare one learning objective and delayed-recall validator before generating exercises.
guardrails: Compilation is not word-for-word linguistic equivalence.
Perception and production outcomes remain separate.

lanes.title: Patent prior art as provenance-bound query compilation
lanes.next_gate: Build a family-normalized query fixture using an allowed official source.
guardrails: Vector similarity is discovery, not patentability.
Respect source terms and access policies.

lanes.title: Crop observations and standards-bound interoperability
lanes.next_gate: Map one observation fixture with an unresolved queue and schema validator.
guardrails: Observation context and license remain attached.
Unmapped fields are explicit loss, not silently dropped truth.

lanes.title: Dental geometry as a semantic-preservation benchmark
lanes.next_gate: Define a geometry-only fixture preserving units, IDs, pose and landmarks across one projection.
guardrails: Geometry does not carry clinical conclusions by itself.
Retractions change source status without deleting historical provenance.

lanes.title: Living garden and Geometry Nodes as projections
lanes.next_gate: Connect one declared analytical snapshot to a visual projection with a loss manifest.
guardrails: Spatial proximity and visual salience do not create epistemic relations.
Blender output is a projection/cache, not the authority.

lanes.title: Vibe coding as observable generation, evaluation and repair
lanes.next_gate: Record one generation-to-integration cycle with rollback and validator evidence.
guardrails: Generation rate is not integration quality.
Discarded outputs and repairs are negative knowledge, not deleted noise.

lanes.title: Digital storage, deduplication and data value without universal scoring
lanes.next_gate: Measure one retention decision with raw/derived/promoted separation and reversible quarantine.
guardrails: Deduplication is not data value.
Value is task-specific and must not erase provenance.

lanes.title: Patronage and outreach as source-backed human-reviewed drafting
lanes.next_gate: Create one source-backed draft with explicit human review and no hidden private telemetry.
guardrails: No universal donor score.
A draft is not a sent message or verified relationship.

lanes.title: Cultural authorship and post-internet provenance
lanes.next_gate: Attach a transformation manifest to one portfolio artifact without inferring authorship from style.
guardrails: Provenance does not prove truth or legal authorship.
Human/machine/hybrid status requires source evidence.

lanes.title: Order/disorder as a reusable search and event vocabulary
lanes.next_gate: Produce one non-mathematical project event fixture so the hypothesis is tested outside P=NP.
guardrails: The analogy to complexity is operational, not a mathematical proof.
Do not collapse disorder into a single universal score.
